source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def runs(vals):
        result=[]
        i=0
        while i < len(vals):
            if vals[i] == bg:
                i += 1
                continue
            color=vals[i]
            j=i+1
            while j < len(vals) and vals[j] == color:
                j += 1
            result.append((color,i,j-1))
            i=j
        return result

    choices=[]
    for orient in ('horizontal','vertical'):
        if orient == 'horizontal':
            a=runs(grid[0]); b=runs(grid[-1]);
        else:
            a=runs([grid[r][0] for r in range(h)])
            b=runs([grid[r][-1] for r in range(h)])
        for ca,sa,ea in a:
            for cb,sb,eb in b:
                if ca == cb:
                    choices.append((ea-sa+eb-sb,orient,ca,(sa,ea),(sb,eb)))
    if not choices:
        return out
    _,orient,line,(s1,e1),(s2,e2)=max(choices)

    markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,line)]
    if not markers:
        return out
    colors=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in markers)
    active=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    markers=[(r,c) for r,c in markers if grid[r][c] == active]

    if orient == 'horizontal':
        tangent=lambda p:p[1]
        near=((0,s1,e1),(h-1,s2,e2))
        def point(t,edge): return (edge,t)
        def cast(p, edge, stop_at_seed=False):
            r,c=p; dr=1 if edge==h-1 else -1
            rr=r+dr
            while 0 <= rr < h and rr != edge:
                if out[rr][c] == bg: out[rr][c]=active
                rr += dr
    else:
        tangent=lambda p:p[0]
        near=((0,s1,e1),(w-1,s2,e2))
        def point(t,edge): return (t,edge)
        def cast(p, edge, stop_at_seed=False):
            r,c=p; dc=1 if edge==w-1 else -1
            cc=c+dc
            while 0 <= cc < w and cc != edge:
                if out[r][cc] == bg: out[r][cc]=active
                cc += dc

    counts=[]
    for edge,lo,hi in near:
        counts.append(sum(lo <= tangent(p) <= hi for p in markers))
    side=0 if counts[0]>=counts[1] else 1
    own=(near[side][0],near[side][1],near[side][2])
    other=near[1-side]
    own_edge,lo,hi=own
    other_edge,olo,ohi=other

    for p in markers:
        t=tangent(p)
        if not lo <= t <= hi: continue
        r,c=p
        out[r][c]=4
        cast(p,own_edge)
        offset=t-lo
        mapped=olo+offset
        if mapped <= ohi:
            # project the marker location onto the opposite boundary and inward
            q=point(mapped,other_edge)
            # include the far edge when it is otherwise background
            r0,c0=q
            if orient == 'horizontal':
                step=1 if other_edge==0 else -1
                rr=r0+step
                while 0 <= rr < h:
                    if out[rr][c0] == bg: out[rr][c0]=active
                    rr += step
            else:
                step=1 if other_edge==0 else -1
                cc=c0+step
                while 0 <= cc < w:
                    if out[r0][cc] == bg: out[r0][cc]=active
                    cc += step
    return out
'''
